rows.en: Don't get in my way!
You think moves like that will do?
I can tell what you're thinking!
I won't let you go any further!
Underestimate me and you'll get hurt!
I decided I'd be Judau's strength. So!
uncertain: Split sentence: Japanese ends with 'so!' as a trailing lead-in; kept.

rows.en: Here's payback!
Now it's my turn!
Not bad at all!
Ngh!! So this is it!!
Uwaaaagh!!
Damn! I'm bailing out!
No, I'm going down!!
!! I can't go down yet!
I-I'll still hold out somehow, you'll see!
Ngh! If I take another hit...!
My armor shouldn't be this flimsy...!
I'm not fighting just to die in a place like this!
Ngh!! You did it now!!
Tch! You'll pay for that!
An attack like that won't bring me down!
Damn! Are my thrusters acting up!?
It's fine, my machine still moves!
Don't think you've beaten me with just this!
With something like this!
Hmph, an attack like this!
Too slow!!
Damn... I couldn't dodge it!?
You can keep up with my moves...!
From that impact, the damage should be light!
I got hit? Me...!?
I can see right through you!!
Hit me if you can!
You think you can fight me with skills like that!?
Not to some machine that's all power!
Too slow!!
You won't hit me!!
An attack that obvious!
What's wrong!? I'm right here!
You're way too slow to take me on!
I've seen through your black pressure!
Hmph! What a waste of effort!!
I've got a barrier, you know!
An attack like that!
Missiles won't work on me!
Looks like the jammer is working normally.
I can dodge all of this!
Too bad, you won't hit me.
Damn, I can't counter!?
Out of range!?
Attacking from that far away...!
I'm going next!
Leave the rest to me!
I'm launching a wave attack!
I'll take a shot too!
Judau, clear the line of fire!
Ple, I'll handle the rest!
uncertain: Ple Two's set addresses Ple directly here (and rows 57, 63, 64).

rows.en: Nice timing, Ple!
I'll take care of this!
Fall back while you can!
I'm cutting in!
It'll hit...!? Get out of the way!
Judau, get back!
Ple, don't push yourself!
I won't let them get Ple!
I'll make the move! Cover me!
I'm attacking in succession!
Roger! I'll cover you!
Here goes, High Mega Launcher!
uncertain: High Mega Launcher not in glossary; literal rendering.

rows.en: Zeta Gundam! Lend me your strength!
uncertain: Ple Two calling on the Zeta Gundam is odd for her; translated literally.

rows.en: Very well... my power, together with everyone's!
Go, go, goooooo!
Don't think you can escape my Funnels!
Funnels, there! Go!!
High Mega Cannon, going at full power!
uncertain: High Mega Cannon not in glossary; standard English name used.

rows.en: I'll clean you all up at once!
Don't think numbers will win it for you!
Fin Funnels, go!
Here it comes!
Okay! Leave it to me!
Can you dodge this many Funnels!?
Underestimate me and you'll get hurt!
Aim reeeal carefully... Right there!
Take this! Take this! Take this!!
Here I goooo!
N-No good, they got meee!
Yikes, I can't take any more!
Waaagh! I'm gonna get wrecked!?
N-No good! I can't hold out any longer!
Whoa-whoa-whoa! I'm going down, going dooown!
Why, you! I'm not done yet!!
Ngh! Why you! I won't let you!
Th-They're strong! B-But hey, I've got my pride too!
Gwah! Y-You'll pay for that!
Gwah! N-Not yet! I'm not going down yet!
I-It just grazed me!
It hit, but... that's all it's got?
Whoa!? ......? Huh, all bark and no bite.
uncertain: Feminine ending in Mondo's set; likely another ZZ teammate (Elle?) sharing it. English kept neutral.

rows.en: Ow! You did it now, why you!
You won't get me!
Whoa! I-It's coming this way!
I can't afford to get hit!
Whoa! Th-They're aiming at me!?
Th-That was close...
Phew, close one, close one.
Nyah nyah!
uncertain: Akkanbe (tongue-out taunt) rendered as 'Nyah nyah!'.

rows.en: I-I'm not scared of a beam like that!
Huh!? What? Am I out of ammo?
No good, it's too far to attack!
Huh!? What!?
Here's a little something extra!
All right! It's my turn!
Times like this, you gotta stay sharp!
Iino, I'm right behind you!
Elle, leave the rest to me!
Judau, I'll give you a hand!
Beecha, leave the rest to me!
I'll give you a hand, Roux!
If you're attacking, come at me!
Wh-Whoa!? It won't stop!?
Nngh! I went in too far!
Run while you can, Iino!
Elle, go now!
What're you doing, Judau!
Beecha, look out!
Roux, look out!
Now!
I'm counting on you!
uncertain: Direction: speaker asking an ally to rely on them; read as 'I'm counting on you' per BASE_RULES.

rows.en: I'm firing!
Waaaaagh!
Take thiiis!
Please work... Funnels!
Funnels!
How about this! High Mega Cannon!!
High Mega Cannon! Fiiire!!
Will this work? Fin Funnels!
All right! Ready, set...!
uncertain: Shared with Leina and Roux; 'Ready, set...!' works for all.

rows.en: Uh, um... which one was it?
uncertain: Leina selecting a weapon (rows 137-138); context inferred.

rows.en: Oh, it's this one.
Kyaaah! B-Big brother!!
Kyaaah! No, I'm gonna get shot down!!
Kyaaah! I-I can't hold out any longer!
Aaugh! H-Help me, big brother!!
Aah! Waah! Wh-What do I do!?
Augh! Wh-Why you! You won't get me!
N-Not yet! I'm going to save my big brother!
Augh! No, stop it!
Huh? Did it hit me?
Not from something like this!
It hit! ...Huh? I'm totally fine!?
No, no, don't come near me!
Kyaah! Oh... I made it...
Kyaah! H-Hey, that was dangerous!!
That won't work on me!
Huh? It won't fire, why!?
What is this? It won't reach!?
Huh?
I-I can do it too!
Get 'em!
High Mega Cannon, here goes!!
I'll shoot you down!
Underestimate me 'cause I'm a girl and you'll get hurt!
uncertain: Shared with Roux Louka; works for both.

rows.en: I'll be your opponent!
So you came my way... You're mine!!
Here it comes! Time to give it my all!!
Don't think I, Roux Louka, am just some girl!
I'm a Newtype too, you know!
I bet I can handle it better than Judau!
No way!? I got shot down!?
Augh! No, I've lost control!!
No, it won't hold!?
Kyaaah! Wh-What power!?
Kyaah! You're kidding, this is seriously bad!
Ngh! Huh!? The power unit's damaged!? Not good...
Wh-What is this!? Nobody told me about this!!
D-Don't think a little thing like this will make me back off!!
N-Not yet! This is where I get to shine!!
Kyaah! P-Pulling through from here is just what I do!
Owww... You'll pay for that!
Tch! Not yet! I won't go down to this!
Augh! Why you, now I'm mad!!
Ugh! You're better than I thought!
Ngh! Why you, you've got some nerve!
Hey! What's the idea, treating a girl like this!?
Huh? Things are starting to look kinda bad...?
Ngh! From here on, I show off my skills!
I was ready for this much damage from the start!
Oh no, did it hit me?
Oh, did something hit me?
As if I'd go down to something like this!
My, you're weaker than I thought.
You think I'll let out a cute little scream over this!?
Kyaaah!! ...Wait, that wasn't as bad as I thought.
Oh, could it be... you're going easy on me?
What... what a boring attack.
Like you'll hit me!
uncertain: Shared with Akitsu Masato; generic wording.

rows.en: From the left? No, it's head-on!!
I'll dodge it!
You suck!
Kyah! Hey, that was dangerous!
I dodged it! Amaaazing, that's me all right!!
That won't work on me!
I evaded it! That's me! Good girl, good girl!
Sorry, but I can't afford to get hit!
Yaaay! Successful evasion!
You missed on purpose for me? How sweet of you!
uncertain: Sarcastic gratitude toward an enemy that missed; 'missed on purpose' is an inference.

rows.en: Aiming at me is useless, useless!
Did you notice you picked the wrong target?
Too bad! Better luck next time!
Judau! Did you see that just now!?
Can my shield hold it all off!?
This is exactly when I need my shield!
Don't you break on me yet!
I can block this much easily!
That kinda stuff is useless, you know~
Amaaazing! I blocked the attack!
I'm telling you, missiles are useless!
I've got something good installed, you know!
uncertain: Defense line about an installed defense (likely I-Field or barrier); 'something good installed' kept vague as in source.

rows.en: Whaaat!? Out of ammo!?
N-No way!? I can't attack!?
I-If this keeps up, I'll be a sitting duck...!
What is it!? Their attacks reach this far!?
Damn, I can't reach them from here!
So they're a cut above me...!
I'll put an end to this!
I can still attack from here too!
This is Roux Louka! I'll provide support!!
Providing covering fire!
This will settle it!
Stay right there!
At least let me do this much!
I'll deal with that one!
Looks like it's my turn!
I won't let you do as you please!
uncertain: Source is a deliberately trailing fragment; rendered as full sentence 'I won't let you do as you please!'.

rows.en: Look out! Fall back!
uncertain: Shared with Akitsu Masato; generic wording.

rows.en: I'll make it in time!
I'm not confident at close range... but I'll do it!
If I close the distance in one go, even I can!
This is the moment of truth... Here I go!!
The closer I get to the enemy, the easier it is to hit!
The enemy's here...! I'll shoot it down with my Long Rifle!!
Dart around all you want, this Long Rifle will get you!!
You won't get away... High Mega Launcher, fire!
With this High Mega Launcher... go down!
Mega Particle Cannon, fire!
I'll master them... Funnels!!
Go! Funnels!!
Funnels, over there! Go!!
I'll shoot you down with my Funnels!
All of Double Zeta's power, into this one shot!!
uncertain: Double Zeta used as spoken name of ZZ Gundam.

rows.en: Goooo!!
Then it's time for my trump card!
Hyper Mega Cannon, fire!!
uncertain: Hyper Mega Cannon not in glossary; literal rendering.

rows.en: I'll take you all at once! High Mega Cannon!!
High-output mode... Mega Particle Cannon, fire!
Go! Fin Funnels!!
I'm counting on you! Fin Funnels!!
Hit!
In that case, my Beam Saber!!
All right, perfect aim! Gooo!!
If I aim properly, I'll hit!
Out of my way!
uncertain: Shared with Amuro Ray; generic wording.

rows.en: Go down!
uncertain: Shared with Hugo Medio and an unnamed set; generic.

rows.en: Augh! Damn it!!
uncertain: Shared with Ken Tetsuya and Ryoma Nagare; generic.

rows.en: Damn! Have I taken too much damage!?
Ugh! A-At this rate, I'll be shot down!?
Ngh! The damage is too heavy!?
I can't go down yet!
Ngh! Is the apogee motor output dropping!?
No good! At this rate, I'll be shot down!?
What!? Are you saying I'm being overpowered!?
uncertain: Reading: Amuro being out-powered in a clash; 'you' as the enemy is an inference.

rows.en: The damage is heavy, but I can't fall back now!
With this little damage, it shouldn't explode yet!
What... putting pressure on me like this!
Not from this!
N-Not yet!
Good! But I'm not done by a long shot!
uncertain: Read as acknowledging the enemy's skill ('Good!' = 'you're good') before refusing to yield.

rows.en: You got me!
Not yet! I haven't been beaten yet!
Tch! Is my machine not fully tuned!?
Ngh! Not yet! I can still go!!
Ugh! Not yet!!
Ngh!! But I can still go with only this much!
Impossible!
Is my machine not fully tuned!?
I've been hit! But there has to be a way!
Machine performance alone doesn't decide a fight!
The enemy's good too...! I can't let my guard down.
The reaction speed is slow!? But I'll manage somehow!
This pressure is standing like a wall against me...!
uncertain: Pressure as Newtype pressure from the enemy, acting as a wall; meaning slightly uncertain.

rows.en: Tch, did I charge too deep into the enemy forces!?
I've still got room... I'll shoot you down next hit!
Tch!
Not like this!!
It just grazed me!
Not a chance, this is nothing!
Ngh! Not yet!
Not from this much!!
Not with this little damage!!
Ngh! I can still go!
I managed to avoid a direct hit!
What, is my machine's reaction speed sluggish?
Less damage than I thought. But I'll dodge the next one!
So their mobility is better than mine...!
No problem, it only grazed my armor.
Pressure like that won't stop me!
No effect on combat, but I can't let my guard down.
I'm no amateur, yet I got hit by this...!
I can... see the enemy's movements!
Not when you close in like that!
Are you determined to get in my way!?
You won't catch my movements that easily!
I've read your attack pattern!
I can't afford to be held up in a place like this!
From the front... no, from the front right!
Here it comes... I'll evade it!
Moves like that, I'll see right through them!
I can see it!!
It's useless!!
Like that'll hit me!
You won't hit me!
Dodged it... Moving to the next action!
Feels good. My reaction speed is going up!
Looks like the apogee motor tuning is working out.
That won't work on me!
Not from this much!!
Don't mock me!
Deploying the I-Field!
Using the I-Field barrier!
Fin Funnels, deploy!
Fin Funnels can be used like this, too!
I'll knock it down with my Beam Saber!
I'll shoot them all down!
I see you! There!
I won't let you break through here!
Damn, out of ammo!
Ngh! Not at this range!
Looks like I need to back them up...!
uncertain: Source has no object; read as Amuro deciding an ally needs support. Unnamed ally rendered as gender-neutral them.

rows.en: I can attack from here too... Go!
Not yet, here I go!
I can still go!
Kamille, fall back! I'll handle the rest!
Judau, leave the rest to me!
Let's keep it up, Bright!
I'll take care of this! Fall back while you can!
What are you doing! You'll get shot down like that!
I'll draw the enemy's fire! Regroup!
From here on!
I'll take care of this!
uncertain: Support-defend line ('I'll look after this'); rendered as 'I'll take care of this!' same as row 344 opener.

rows.en: That was careless, Kamille!
You're too far forward, Judau!
Bright, you're too far forward!
You can't dodge this combination!
Don't let the target escape!
Let's attack all at once!!
With this!
I'll hit it!
I'm in the enemy's range... Here I go!
If I can just stop its movements!
If I get in close, it can't attack me!
I should be able to handle melee combat, too!
Closing the distance, I'm going in close!
Locked on... High Mega Launcher, go!
uncertain: High Mega Launcher in Amuro's set too; same literal name as Roux's.

rows.en: High-output mode... Go!
With my firepower, I should be able to finish it!
Allies, fall back! I'm firing the High Mega Cannon!
If I don't finish it in one shot, my allies will be hurt...!
Engaging in close combat!
With the Fin Funnels, I can win!
Fin Funnels... the target is the enemy ahead!
There! Fin Funnels!
Hit!
Here it comes!? There!
It's in range... I can attack!
Your evasion is slow! I'll score a direct hit!
So you've come forward... Then!
